statement: Let K be any field and let I be a proper (x,y,z)-primary monomial ideal in K[x,y,z]. If the unique minimal monomial generating set of I has at most four members and every such member has total degree at most four, then v(overline(I)) <= v(I), with v-number and integral-closure conventions exactly as frozen in source.md and problem.md.
contribution: A complete labeled enumeration of all 517 admissible exponent antichains, with a correctness proof and two independently coded exact checks: primal rational active-set feasibility plus neighbor socles, and dual integer Newton inequalities plus closed-form/global-maximal socles. The methods agree on every membership bitmap, full socle list, and v-number; all 517 differences v(overline(I))-v(I) are nonpositive, and both methods detect the cited degree-five positive control.
